name: csswg-drafts
readme_excerpt: Types of Workflows workflows/build-specs.yml - builds the entire repository of Editor's Drafts, along with a summary page. Also builds any .issues Issues-List files, and Markdown files. Deploys all the results to the repo's gh-pages workflows/SPEC-NAME-1.yml - each of these auto-publish one spec in the repo. Do not modify them by hand; they are auto-generated by generate-auto-publish-workflows.py and auto-publish-template.yml. Instead, update and run this .py file and commit the results.
